description: This file defines a ThreadPool class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, including nested classes for job management, worker threads, and minions, as well as interfaces for dispatching tasks. It provides thread pool management functionalities such as submitting, revoking, starting, and stopping worker threads, and managing task queues.

classes.name: ThreadPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of worker threads, task queue, and task dispatching.

classes.name: ThreadPool::IDispatcher
classes.description: Interface for dispatching tasks, with methods for initialization, deinitialization, and dispatching.

classes.name: ThreadPool::JobType<IMPLEMENTATION>
classes.description: Represents a job with a specific implementation, managing its state and dispatching.

classes.name: ThreadPool::Minion
classes.description: Represents a worker entity that processes tasks from the queue using a dispatcher.

classes.name: ThreadPool::Executor
classes.description: A thread wrapper that runs a Minion and manages its lifecycle.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the number of worker threads in the pool.

methods.name: Pending
methods.description: Returns the number of pending tasks in the queue.

methods.name: Runs
methods.description: Fills the provided counters array with the number of runs for each thread.

methods.name: Active
methods.description: Returns the number of active worker threads.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Returns the thread ID of the worker at the specified index.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits a task to the queue, with optional wait time.

methods.name: Post
methods.description: Posts a task to the queue without waiting.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Removes a task from the queue and waits for its completion if necessary.

methods.name: Queue
methods.description: Returns a reference to the task queue.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops all worker threads and disables the queue.
